_readme: Settings shared by every game. Edit freely; the dashboard explains each number using these values.

buying._note: Estimates for what you actually pay: cheapest listing + shipping + sales tax (Anaheim, CA).

zones._note: How the buy labels are decided, using the last 90 days of market prices.

benchmark._note: Federal long-term rates used for the after-tax comparison. Collectibles are taxed up to 28%; stocks at 15% for most people.
